statement.text:
What are the nonabelian composition factors of a finite nonsoluble group all
of whose maximal subgroups have complements?
    Note that finite simple groups with all maximal subgroups having complements
are, up to isomorphism, L2 (7), L2 (11), and L5 (2) (V. M. Levchuk, A. G. Likharev,
Siberian Math. J., 47, no. 4 (2006), 659–668). The same groups exhaust finite simple
groups with Hall maximal subgroups and composition factors of groups with Hall
maximal subgroups (N. V. Maslova, Siberian Math. J., 53, no. 5 (2012), 853–861).
It is also proved that in a finite group with Hall maximal subgroups all maximal
subgroups have complements (N. V. Maslova, D. O. Revin, Siberian Adv. Math., 23,
no. 3 (2013), 196–209).                                  N. V. Maslova, D. O. Revin
